steps.title: Open the tape cockpit
steps.narration: We start on Tapeology's home screen with nothing being watched yet. The cockpit sits quietly idle, waiting for a stock to read.
steps.point_out: The body reads "No ticker watched" and the status dot at the top-right is grey — and notice there is no Stop button while the screen is idle.

steps.title: Enter a ticker to watch
steps.narration: We type the built-in sample stock SIM-BUYER into the ticker box at the top.
steps.point_out: SIM-BUYER now fills the ticker field, ready to be watched.

steps.title: Watch the live read
steps.narration: Clicking Watch brings the stock to life — the cockpit fills with the live tape and calls who is in control, settling on Buyer Control.
steps.point_out: The top bar now shows "Watching SIM-BUYER" with a new rose Stop button beside it, while the body shows the live read: prices, recent trades, tape measurements, and the overall tape-state call with its confidence.

steps.title: Stop watching
steps.narration: Pressing the new Stop button ends the watch on demand and clears the screen straight back to a clean idle state — with no frozen numbers left behind.
steps.point_out: The body returns to "No ticker watched", the "Watching SIM-BUYER" label and the Stop button both disappear, and the status dot goes back to grey idle — nothing stale remains on screen.

steps.title: Re-enter the same ticker
steps.narration: To show the watch truly reset, we type SIM-BUYER back into the ticker box for a second watch.
steps.point_out: SIM-BUYER is back in the ticker field, ready for a fresh watch from a cold start.

steps.title: A fresh cold-start read
steps.narration: Watching again rebuilds the read from scratch — the cockpit repopulates cold and settles on Buyer Control once more, rather than showing a stale leftover frame.
steps.point_out: The cockpit fills in fresh from a cold start and resolves to Buyer Control again, confirming a brand-new read of the stock rather than the previous session frozen in place.
